quality.title: Quality Control Processes
quality.heroHeading: A quality flow measured, reported and re-verified at every stage.
quality.heroLead: Through rigorous quality inspections at every stage of production, we deliver consistent, traceable and reliable products. From sampling to packing, each step is recorded and supported by continuous improvement.

layers.title: A verification structure extending from sampling to shipment.

detailedLists.title: Control headings are visible and reported one by one.

sample.title: The initial approval stage forms the reference point for the entire quality flow that follows.
sample.body: Measurements, surface quality, stitching and material compatibility are clarified at this stage.

reporting.title: Control findings are not only identified, but also recorded and turned into action.
reporting.body: This visibility makes quality discipline sustainable.

sample.title: Sample
sample.desc: Measurements, seam and wash evaluations are performed during the sampling stage.

production.title: Production
production.desc: Ongoing inspections during cutting and sewing processes.

packing.title: Packing
packing.desc: Final checks and labeling before packaging.

assurance.title: Quality Assurance
assurance.desc: Quality assurance is ensured through continuous monitoring, data recording and feedback mechanisms; recall and corrective action procedures are applied when required.

how.title: How we work
how.heading: Every control step is recorded and connected to the improvement cycle.
how.lead: Below you can find the main headings of our quality control processes and application examples. Standard Operating Procedures (SOP) are applied and recorded at each step.
steps: The measurement chart, seam quality, fabric behavior and first appearance approval are evaluated together during the sampling stage.
Defined critical control points in cutting, sewing and intermediate operations are monitored at regular intervals throughout production.
Before packing, labeling and shipment preparation, final verifications are carried out to minimize the risk of non-conformities.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: We care about protecting your personal data and processing it transparently and securely. This page summarizes which data we collect, how we use it and your rights.

sections.lead1: We care about protecting your personal data. Below we summarize which data we collect, how we use it and your rights. For details, please contact us.
sections.lead2: We implement reasonable technical and administrative measures to protect your data. For privacy questions, requests or complaints, please contact us.
sections.personalData: Your name, email address, phone number and other information you enter into contact forms. We may also collect cookies and technical data related to site usage (IP address, browser information, page views, etc.).
sections.whyUse: We use collected data to respond to your requests, deliver and improve our services, manage order and information request processes and to fulfill our legal obligations.
sections.sharing: Your data is not shared with third parties unless you give explicit consent or when required by law. Limited, purpose-bound sharing with subcontractors (e.g., shipping, payment providers) may occur; such transfers are carried out securely.
sections.rights: Right to access and correct your data; right to request deletion or restriction of processing; right to object to processing and data portability.
sections.cookies: Performance and analytics cookies may be used on the site. You can manage or disable cookies via your browser settings; some features may not function properly if cookies are disabled.
sections.securityContact: We apply reasonable technical and administrative measures to protect your data. For privacy-related questions, requests or complaints, please contact us.
